items.evidence: Check reservoir_columns_within_15ml failed: ethanol columns 9 and 10 are each drawn 16000 uL (ethanol[i % 4] sends two columns of wash volume to each), exceeding the 15 mL well capacity.
fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed (48 distinct tips, no violations); p1000 uses a new tip per sample, p300 uses a fresh tip per column for removals, and every tip is dropped.
All 14 steps are in order with correct volumes, delays (5 min, 4 min, 4 min, 30 s, 90 s), magnet states and 4 C setting, and comments match the code.
48_samples_to_odd_columns and distinct_elution_wells passed; tubes_10 + tubes_7 map one-to-one to the 48 odd-column wells.
The code adds 40 uL beads, 250 uL isopropanol, then 250 uL sample with a 5x mix, a 5 min delay, the magnet engaged for 4 min, and removal of 540 uL with the magnet on; the related checks passed.

Two 500 uL ethanol washes are each removed with the magnet engaged, followed by a 4 min delay with the magnet still engaged and then a disengage before elution; two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed.
The code disengages, adds 100 uL, mixes, waits 30 s, engages for 90 s, then transfers 80 uL to a distinct well; recover_about_80ul passed.

judge.summary: The protocol follows every step with correct volumes, timings, magnet states and per-sample tip handling, and all but one run-log check passed. It loses robot_practice because the ethanol reservoir columns 9 and 10 are each drawn 16 mL, over the 15 mL well capacity.
